posts.title: Are these the role models?
posts.description: Society needs better role models or none at all. Over the last few centuries (and perhaps even a thousand years or two), men who’ve attained extraordinary wealth and power are often touted as role models. posts.title: Why Productivity Needs to be Redefined
posts.description: In the age of AI, I wonder how humans and organizations will perceive productivity. During the onset of the Industrial Age, productivity was defined by efficiency. The more you did and faster you worked, the more productive you were perceived to be. Today, we talk about new large language models in similar terms — how fast they are at complex tasks and how much they get done. Call this the widget
